BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, tsippôwr is the word for a bird, a little bird. In Genesis 7:14, every bird of every sort, and it appears again in Leviticus 14:4.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the birds in the ark and in the cleansing rite both tell me God counts the small creatures too.
